quarterly_data.quarter: Munters press release: Munters completes expansion of data center cooling campus (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Munters inaugurated its expanded data center cooling campus in Daleville, Virginia (close to 600 employees, 565,000 square feet / 52,000 m2), the largest of five dedicated Data Center Technologies manufacturing facilities; it produces the whole data center cooling portfolio - air side economizers, SyCool Split, CRAHs, fan coil arrays, CDUs and now chillers - and the expansion launched local manufacturing of chillers previously produced in Italy, including the Circlemiser chiller; the site also houses the Munters Service Academy, new production test stands and a chiller laboratory.
